item.title: Bayesian Statistics
item.description: (or “Why Plaid Will Never Go Out of Style”) Knowing when to change your mind about something is one of the toughest things we have to do. “Maaaaybe it’s time to update my wardrobe…” Over time, we may see evidence pop up that contradicts our opinion. But, how do we know when there’s enough evidence for us to change our minds? One way we can approach this problem analytically is with Bayesian statistics.
